newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues tender to buy March crude oil.
newsitem.headline: India issues tender to buy March crude oil.

text.p: India's state-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy one million barrels of March loading crude oil, traders said on Friday.
The tender seeks a wide range of crude oils, including Middle East, West African, Asian and North Sea grades.
The tender closes at 0800 hours New Delhi time on January 30 and offers should be valid until 2200 hours on January 31.
In its February buying tender, India awarded one Dubai crude cargo and three very large crude carriers of Qua Iboe crude oil.
